verdict.rationale: Live customer support is a fair question for a business banking product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents support channels, hours of availability, phone or chat support, or urgent escalation for account issues. The evidence covers APIs, MCP, cards, invoicing, sandbox and FDIC coverage, none of which bears on live support availability.

support.subject: As a founder, I can reach live customer support at any time for urgent account issues
